title: Why-Now Wire
tagline: Watches a book of accounts for fresh, independently confirmed changes and drafts the outreach, held for a human to approve.
phase: Designed; live probe tonight decides whether a weekend gives it enough to show
bottomLine: The highest-ceiling path, for the Live Wire track. It sweeps recent news for a list of accounts, fires a trigger only when two independent sources confirm the same change, remembers what it has already seen, and drafts outreach that cites the trigger, held for approval. The question is whether a quiet weekend gives it real triggers to show live.
healthReason: Feasible on the shared engine, but the demo depends on the world producing corroborated news on the day, and weekends are quiet.
pathToGreen: Green if tonight's probe finds at least two corroborated triggers across the account list in a 24-hour window. If not, it stays a stretch path.
why: Sellers learn about a funding round, a leadership change or a launch days late, from a stale enrichment record or a teammate. The do-nothing baseline is a weekly manual scan of the news, or a single-source alert that fires on rumours.
mission: An account watcher. Fresh-news searches over a list of accounts, a ledger of what has been seen so nothing alerts twice, a trigger rule that needs two independent domains, the verification engine on the trigger's claims, and an outreach draft citing the event, held for approval.
destination: On stage, a change that happened in the last day appears as a confirmed trigger with two sources, and the drafted message cites it, waiting for approval. Done when a live sweep produces that without hand-picking the story.
showcase: Corroboration before action: two independent sources or no trigger
Polling plus a seen-ledger, a simple form of change data capture that never alerts twice
Human approval as the default for anything that goes out

milestones.title: Probe: corroborated triggers in a 24-hour window
Live sweep producing a held, cited draft

assumptions.assumption: A list of around fifteen active companies yields at least one corroborated change per day, even on a weekend
assumptions.test: Sweep the list tonight with a one-day freshness window and count triggers with two independent domains

risks.risk: Nothing happens on the day, and the demo shows an empty feed
risks.mitigation: Widen the list to fast-moving sectors and keep a recorded real sweep as a labelled replay

risks.risk: Syndicated copies of one story look like independent confirmation
risks.mitigation: Count distinct original publishers, not distinct URLs

nextSteps.action: Run the 24-hour trigger sweep on a test list
